_comment: Driving situations used as stimuli. clip: source dashcam video (not in git). start_s/duration_s: the part of it used. event_s: when the car reacts, in source-clip seconds; the display is shown around it. why/how/manoeuvre: the explanation texts. camera: flat-ground constants for this clip at 1280x720 (check them with render_stimuli.py --calibrate). geometry: overlay geometry for the clip; empty = data/geometry/<id>_geometry.jsonl.gz, written by extract_geometry.py. comprehension: the clip stops at stop_s (source-clip seconds) and the participant answers what the car does next; correct must match what the footage shows after stop_s. verified: whether a person checked the answer against the footage. country: ISO 3166 code of where the clip was filmed (compared with participants' country of residence). criticality: low or high, how risky the situation is; the analysis compares preferences between the two.

comprehension.question: What will the car do next?
